elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The clause addresses system capability and conformity with the Agreement, but does not require professional and workmanlike performance.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Reports, as deliverables, must be in substantial conformity with the customer bulletins and User Manuals.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: No 12-month software conformance warranty is provided; the express 90-day period applies to reports.
The minimum period following performance of each Service is only 30 days.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: M&I must promptly repair or replace non-conforming Services or reports.
Customer may elect a refund of fees paid for non-conforming Services or reports.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws appears.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The 90-day documentation-conformance warranty covers reports, not the software itself; the software provision addresses only system capability.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Section 16.1 warranties remain effective for at least 30 days following performance of each Service, with remedies for non-conforming Services.
